Connect an Epson printer over USB OTG, then tap the refresh button
Resetting does not clean the pad
The counter is electronic; the pad is physical. Wash, replace or redirect the waste ink before resetting, or ink will eventually leak inside the printer.
No counter to reset on this model
This printer does not keep a waste ink counter the app can reset. Nothing is broken: neither the app nor the printer is at fault.

This model\'s counter ceiling is not published, so there is no percentage to aim at. The reset writes the values published for this model, across every address it lists.

This printer uses a maintenance box
The waste ink goes into a box, and the box records the level on its own chip. There is no counter in the printer for the app to reset — when the box fills, it is replaced.
Your printer uses a maintenance box

The waste ink from head cleaning collects in a maintenance box rather than in pads inside the printer. The box carries its own chip that records how full it is, and the printer keeps no counter of its own — so there is nothing here for any reset utility to clear.

When the box is full it is replaced, or its chip is reset with a dedicated tool. Neither is something an app can do over USB.

You can confirm this on the printer itself: its status panel names the maintenance box, and warns you when the box needs changing.

Head cleaning and the nozzle check still work on this printer. They are on the Maintenance page.
Where the waste ink count lives

Epson stores the waste ink count in one of two places.

Internal pad: the ink is absorbed by pads inside the printer and the fill level is kept in the printer's own memory. This is the case this app can reset.

Maintenance box: the ink collects in a box you can remove, and the box carries its own chip that records the fill level. The printer's memory holds no counter, so no software can clear it. The box is replaced, or its chip is reset with a dedicated tool.

To find out which one you have, check the printer's own status panel. If it reports a maintenance box, no reset utility can help.

If your printer uses an internal pad and you still see this, the model is simply missing from the app's database. That one is fixable, and we would like to hear about it.

Head cleaning and the nozzle check still work on this printer. They are on the Maintenance page.
